description: Search postgres commit messages (or file paths with search_in=paths) by keywords, newest first (all words must appear, case-insensitive; like `git log -i --grep` with every word). Each commit: sha (40-hex, cite it), commit_id, message, author, date, people credited, and mail_refs: up to 5 messages that refer to it {inbox, message_id, subject, url, how_it_refers: discussion-trailer, committers-announcement or mentions-hash}. repository defaults to postgres; limit default 50, max 200. Details with commit_history.

repository.description: Repository name, e.g. pgbouncer. Defaults to postgres when omitted. Aliases: repo, repo_name.

search_in.description: What to search: "messages" (commit messages, default) or "paths" (file paths)

name: git_search
